# DeepWiki

> > AI-powered conversational documentation platform that transforms GitHub repositories into interactive, queryable knowledge bases.

DeepWiki provides intelligent documentation for popular open-source projects across machine learning, web development, and infrastructure. It enables developers to explore complex codebases through natural language conversations powered by AI.

## Key Topics

- LLM Integration
- API Documentation
- Machine Learning
- Python SDK
- Web Automation
- RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
- System Architecture
- Developer Tools
- GitHub Repositories
- TypeScript
- Neural Networks
- Task Queues
- Schema Validation
- PDF Parsing
- Agent Frameworks

## LLM & AI Frameworks

- [langchain-ai/langchain](https://deepwiki.com/langchain-ai/langchain): Modular framework for composable LLM applications with integrations
- [huggingface/transformers](https://deepwiki.com/huggingface/transformers): 400+ ML models for text, vision, audio, multimodal tasks
- [eosphoros-ai/DB-GPT](https://deepwiki.com/eosphoros-ai/DB-GPT): AI-native data application framework with RAG and multi-agent support
- [agent0ai/agent-zero](https://deepwiki.com/agent0ai/agent-zero): LLM-powered agent framework with memory and MCP tool integration
- [karpathy/nanochat](https://deepwiki.com/karpathy/nanochat): Complete LLM training and deployment system with complexity dial
- [infiniflow/ragflow](https://deepwiki.com/infiniflow/ragflow): Retrieval-Augmented Generation engine with document understanding

## API SDKs & Client Libraries

- [openai/openai-python](https://deepwiki.com/openai/openai-python): Official client library for OpenAI API endpoints
- [anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python](https://deepwiki.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python): Official Claude API client with async support

## Development Tools & Infrastructure

- [microsoft/vscode](https://deepwiki.com/microsoft/vscode): VS Code architecture overview: editor systems, extensions, workbench, debugging
- [microsoft/playwright](https://deepwiki.com/microsoft/playwright): Cross-browser web automation and testing framework overview
- [celery/celery](https://deepwiki.com/celery/celery): Distributed task queue framework architecture and concurrency models
- [redis/redis](https://deepwiki.com/redis/redis): In-memory data structure store architecture and internals overview
- [colinhacks/zod](https://deepwiki.com/colinhacks/zod): TypeScript-first schema validation library with static type inference

## Machine Learning & Neural Networks

- [Tencent/ncnn](https://deepwiki.com/Tencent/ncnn): High-performance neural network inference for mobile and edge devices
- [opendatalab/MinerU](https://deepwiki.com/opendatalab/MinerU): High-accuracy PDF/image parsing to Markdown and JSON formats

## Visualization & Search

- [mermaid-js/mermaid](https://deepwiki.com/mermaid-js/mermaid): JavaScript diagram visualization library with plugin system
- [nextapps-de/flexsearch](https://deepwiki.com/nextapps-de/flexsearch): High-performance full-text search library for browser and Node.js

## Optional

- [linshenkx/prompt-optimizer](https://deepwiki.com/linshenkx/prompt-optimizer): Multi-platform AI prompt optimization tool with monorepo structure
- [hackjutsu/Lepton](https://deepwiki.com/hackjutsu/Lepton): Electron desktop app for GitHub Gist code snippet management
